subject: RELATIVE KEY clause
notes: GR1: 'The first logical record has a relative record number of 1, and subsequent logical records have relative record numbers of 2, 3, 4, ...' (cite.py --check 12.4.5.13.4 "The first logical record has a relative record number of 1" -> OK). The runtime store is keyed by 1-based RRN (RelativeConnector.cs:24 slot store, :522 `into.Put(i + 1, rec)`). Probe rk4 (pinned cobol.exe): ACCESS SEQUENTIAL OPEN OUTPUT, three WRITEs with RELATIVE KEY preset to 77 -> key item reads 0001, 0002, 0003 after each (FS 00); sequential READs return AAAA K=0001, BBBB K=0002; DYNAMIC random READ with key 0 -> INVALID KEY, FS=23; random WRITE with key 0 -> FS=34, which is what §14.9.51.4 GR29 b) requires for a value less than 1 (cite.py --find located it: §14.9.51.4 29) b)). Ordinal-position semantics also observed via START NOT LESS THAN 4 -> READ NEXT returns RRN 7 record. No spec-derived golden asserts the output-mode numbering starting at 1 (l1_read_relative_key_moved writes with explicit keys 1..3), so test-ref is empty = test-needed.
